Definition: Milcah, the name of a Hebrewess and of an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Milcah = "queen"; 1) daughter of Haran and wife of Nahor, her uncle and Abraham's brother, to whom she bore 8 children; 2) a daughter of Zelophehad and granddaughter of Manasseh
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
